name: Tim Huelskamp
bio: A Representative from Kansas; born in Fowler, Meade County, Kans., November 11, 1968; B.A., College of Santa Fe, Santa Fe, N.M., 1991; Ph.D., American University, Washington, D.C., 1995; farmer; legislative analyst; member of Kansas state senate, 1996-2010; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Twelfth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2011-January 3, 2017); unsuccessful candidate for renomination to the One Hundred Fifteenth Congress in 2016.
